complexity.notes: result is initialized to 1, which is correct because the constraints guarantee n >= 1; an empty input would incorrectly return 1. Division produces floats, but given the constraint bounds (positions/times up to 10^6) this is safe from precision issues here, though Fraction or cross-multiplication would be more robust. No hashing is used, so worst case matches average case.
complexity.summary: Sort cars by position, then scan from closest to the target backward, tracking the lead car's arrival time; a car forms a new fleet only if its arrival time is strictly later than the current lead's, otherwise it merges. Counts fleets via pop-based iteration over the sorted list.
